replicate_statements: The data are presented as mean ± SD. Statistical analysis involved Student's t‐test and one‐way ANOVA followed by post hoc Tukey's HSD (honestly significant difference) test.
outputs.explanation: Panel A shows quantified bar graphs with mean ± SD and statistical tests (t-test, ANOVA+Tukey), so replicated data is involved. An n-number (N=4) is given on the figure, but it is not specified what the n represents (e.g., number of mice/animals, biological replicates, or independent experiments), and it is unclear whether N=4 applies to all three subcellular fraction graphs or only the mitochondrial one. Because the replicate type is not stated, the panel fails the replication-reporting check.
Panel B shows representative immunoelectron microscopy images without quantification, error bars, or statistical analysis, so replicate reporting is not required.

Panel C is a representative Western blot comparing HMGB1 detection across different mitochondrial purification methods, with no quantification, error bars, or statistics presented, so no replicate reporting is required.
Panel D is a representative Western blot from a proteinase K protection assay with no quantification, error bars, or statistical testing, so replicate reporting is not applicable.
